class_evidence.method: Scanline midpoint strictly inside first official PSR polygon; native raster class is 1

definitions.center: Nearest center of a native class-1 pixel within search radius
definitions.boundary: Nearest 1/0 interface of the union of native 20 m pixel squares, inverse projected to the sphere; distance minimized continuously along edges
definitions.area: Zero inside PSR; otherwise nearest boundary distance
definitions.bearing: Initial true-north clockwise azimuth; null at geographic pole or zero distance
definitions.distance: Spherical geodesic on R=1737400 m; no terrain path or elevation correction
